items.title: Ukraine says Russian drone attack sinks ship in Romanian waters
items.description: The latest suspected incursion on NATO's eastern flank increases fears that the war in Ukraine threatens to spill over.

items.title: Zelensky condemns 'horrific' Russian strike on boat carrying corn in Black Sea
items.description: The vessel's captain was killed and 11 crew members were rescued after the attack on the Turkish-owned ship, Ukraine's leader says.

items.title: Constant atmosphere of war is gripping Kyiv residents: 'The enemy is destroying the city'
items.description: Since Russian strikes intensified at the end of August, daily life in the Ukrainian capital has been marked by air raid alerts and bombings, upending the lives of residents, who, for now, are refusing to resign themselves to a new exodus.

items.title: Yemen government forces announce offensive on Houthi-held territory
items.description: The internationally recognised Yemeni government announced on Sunday the launch of an offensive ‌to recapture territory held by Houthi rebels, with President Rashad al-Alimi swearing to fight "until the country is liberated from the grip of the terrorist militia".

items.title: Drones buzz overhead, troops hunker underground in Ukraine's hellish kill zone
items.description: The front line in the Russia-Ukraine war stretches more than 700 miles and has barely moved in four years. Yet straddling this line is the kill zone, dominated by constantly evolving drone technology.

items.title: Netanyahu, 'il regime iraniano è destinato a sparire'
Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan
items.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) has strongly condemned a deadly airstrike on two clearly marked aid trucks in South Kordofan, Sudan, this past weekend.

items.title: Ukrainian Singer Returns Home From US To Perform For Ukrainian Soldiers Near Front Line
items.description: After studying at Berklee and building a career in New York, Ukrainian singer Valeriia Vovk returned home to perform for troops, including near the front. She says simply being there, talking to soldiers and singing for them, has great value.

items.title: In Tigray, Ethiopian government forces have advanced against a northern rebel group, reports indicate
items.description: Reports indicate Ethiopian government forces have made advances against a northern rebel group. Renewed fighting has raised fears the conflict could spill over into the wider region.

items.title: Ukraine Will Hit Russian Refineries in Response to Moscow's ‘New Doctrine’ of Airstrikes
items.description: Zelensky says Russia's shift represents Putin's desire to appear strong at a time when his military is losing ground in a key frontline region.
